title: Kusanagi Nene — Getting You Snacks〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: ArcLand

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Phew...
Another hard workshop...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, let's sing a song that'll turn your frown upside down!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We did enough singing today, so I'll pass...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I understand how you feel. We were given quite an earful today regarding our singing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But it was also an incredible experience.
I mean, THE Natalia Santi was our teacher today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And her lesson was so detailed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She went over everything from emotional expression to breath control...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It was really amazing how she was able to go around to all of us and give everyone good advice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it was.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Speaking of her, Nene, you seemed to spend a lot of time talking to her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Remember how we broke off into groups to practice that song? I couldn't quite make out what you two were saying from my corner of the room, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I also saw you two talking!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ms. Natalia was smiling so much!
But you looked like a nervous robot, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Of course I was nervous. Who wouldn't be while talking to Natalia Santi?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, what did she tell you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, she told me that I had a good understanding of the song, and that I did a good job of channeling my feelings into it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, and that's coming from a renowned actress...!
Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ After all, she is Wonderlands×Showtime's famed songstress!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You guys are blowing things way out of proportion...! She went over what I was missing too, all sorts of stuff...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, to be fair, I'm glad she did.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course. The workshop is far from over, after all.
Things you're missing now are things you can grow into.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She taught us some good training regimens too, so let's do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you guys are right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I really need to study more...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Study? Are you talking about singing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, English...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We were able to communicate thanks to the interpreter they had present...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I would have liked to be able to speak with her directly. Little nuances can be so important for acting, and singing too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, it's really important to be able to picture if you wanna be ba-bam or more tra-la-la!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure about your choice of words... But yeah, that about covers it. It's just even harder to express in English.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
We will need to have good language skills in the future.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If we're serious about performing around the world, then that's something we won't be able to avoid.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What is it? Why the look of surprise?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, what you just said reminded me of our trip to the United States.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It feels like you've grown a lot from that time when you tried to just bulldoze your way through conversations.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If I have, it's precisely because of that experience.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I do still believe that gumption and enthusiasm can take you far. However, that incident was a painful lesson in the importance of vocabulary even so.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Getting to meet these teachers from abroad is a golden opportunity for us. Perhaps the time has come for us to grapple with English in seriousness!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna work harder on my English, too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna learn more about how amusement parks are run overseas!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You two sound really motivated.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, once this workshop is over, why don't we start holding some study sessions for English and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (English, huh...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Shiraishi and Shinonome did a lot of studying before going over to the United States.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I might ask them what they did to prepare after they get back.)
